race.comment: EVICTION NOTICE (8) led for the judge first-up over this distance at Warwick Farm but was no match for the winner in the concluding stages. Finished second in the Group 2 Silver Slipper when second-up last prep. Sure to come on from that last effort and is going to take plenty of catching with Tim Clark in the saddle. THREADS (12) is back after a five-month spell. Raced twice in the maiden prep, both times at stakes level, and was far from disgraced. Two lead-up trials should have him ready to run well. SEQUINNED (13) last raced on 14 February when a close sixth over this distance at Randwick. Nicely in on 54kgs and is drawn to perfection. Good set-up for her return. WANDA'S SPARK (14) is a Tagaloa filly on debut for Michael Freedman. The winner of both trials so deserves plenty of respect. Doubt the winner will come outside this quartet.
